unit.why: A single narrative about the holy rabbi Maharad"b: he sighs over his family's poverty, a heavenly voice tells him he has lost the World to Come, and his share is restored when he resolves to serve God with no reward. It closes with a moral lesson.
unit.boundary_note: Ends with the closing formula of letter פ ('סליק אות פ') and the heading for the next section ('מענין צדיק').

stories.start_quote: סיפרו לי מעשה רב מאת הה״ק
stories.end_quote: שהכל מצד רחמנותו ית״ש. (א״ד אות ב׳)
stories.summary_en: While living in poverty and seclusion, the tzaddik sighs at his wife's tearful account of their hungry children. A heavenly voice says he has lost his share in the World to Come; he trembles, resolves to serve God purely without hope of reward, and Heaven restores his share but warns him never to sigh over his children again.

quotes: פ״א באה אשתו והתחילה לספר לו בבכיה
באה אשתו והתחילה לספר לו בבכיה מגודל דחקות בניו
tags.why: The wife's complaint triggers his sigh and the heavenly decree.
Shows the tzaddik living in deep poverty and accepting it.
He was living in seclusion at the time.

quotes: שמע קול שאמרו לו מן השמים
אז בשרוהו מן השמים שהחזירוהו לחיי עוה״ב
tags.why: He hears a voice from Heaven and later receives a heavenly announcement.

quotes: שמע קול שאמרו לו מן השמים שכבר אבד חלקו מן עוה״ב
tags.why: A direct heavenly disclosure is made to him.
He is afraid at losing both worlds.
His share in the World to Come is the central issue.
He interrupts his Torah study and then resumes it.

quotes: שלא יתאנח עוד מחמת גודל רחמנותו על בניו
tags.why: Sighing and worry are treated as a spiritual fault.
Heaven forbids him to sigh again.
He loses his share in the World to Come for sighing.

quotes: ותהיה עבודתי באמת רק לעשות נחת רוח
tags.why: Illustrates selfless service of God and acceptance of His decree.
The story shows the tzaddik's pure service of God and trust in Him.

quotes: יצא לנו מזה לקבל גזירתו ית״ש באהבה
tags.why: The narrative ends in an explicit moral lesson.
Heaven acts as an agent, although the action is not set there.

missing_concepts: serving God without hope of reward (avodah lishmah)
accepting divine decree with love (bitachon / trust in God)
